paragraphs: Shimon ha-Amsoni; some say Nehemyah ha-Amsoni, see his entry. He used to expound every et in the Torah, and so forth; see his entry. When he reached “You shall fear et the Lord your God,” he withdrew, until R' Akiva came and expounded it as including Torah scholars. See Megalleh Amukkot, ofan 73: “He brought Shimon out to them”—from that episode it came about that R' Shimon ha-Amsoni expounded et, and so did R' Akiva, who was Shimon's reincarnation.
